added.title: Director of Product Innovation
added.description:
Company Description
InterCapital Digital Wealth Management is a financial services organization focused on delivering technology-driven investment and wealth management solutions. The company leverages digital platforms, data, and automation to help clients manage and grow their assets efficiently and transparently. InterCapital emphasizes innovation, client-centric design, and scalable digital products that support diverse financial goals. Team members collaborate across product, technology, and operations to build secure, compliant, and user-friendly wealth management experiences.
Role Description
The Director of Product Innovation is a full-time remote role responsible for defining and leading the strategy for new and enhanced digital wealth management products. This role oversees the end-to-end product lifecycle, from idea generation and market analysis through requirements definition, design, development, and launch. Day-to-day responsibilities include setting product vision and roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives, and aligning cross-functional teams across product, technology, operations, and marketing. The director conducts quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify customer needs, competitive trends, and performance metrics, translating insights into actionable product decisions. This role also mentors product managers, facilitates collaboration, manages key projects and timelines, and ensures new products meet regulatory, security, and usability standards while delivering measurable business value.
Qualifications

Strong product strategy skills, including ability to define vision, roadmap, and value propositions for digital financial products.
Advanced analytical skills to interpret data, assess market trends, build business cases, and track product performance metrics.
Proven experience in product management, overseeing full product lifecycles in fintech, wealth management, or related digital platforms.
Demonstrated team leadership capabilities, including mentoring product professionals and driving cross-functional alignment.
Solid project management skills to manage complex initiatives, prioritize work, and deliver on time and within scope.
Experience working in or with digital wealth management, investment platforms, or other regulated financial services environments.
Ability to operate effectively in a remote setting, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or similar) is a plus.
Familiarity with agile product development methodologies and partnering closely with UX/UI and engineering teams.
Commitment to inclusive, ethical, and client-focused product practices, with attention to compliance and risk management.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Market Expansion – Merchant Central
added.description:
NMI's SaaS products power how ISOs and ISVs manage their entire merchant lifecycle—from pipeline and onboarding to underwriting, boarding, residuals, and support. Today, that's a US-only story. This role exists to change that.

As Sr. Product Manager for Market Expansion, you will take Merchant Central global. You'll start with Canada—integrating new strategic processors into our SaaS products and building the foundation for a Canadian-market-ready product—then extend the roadmap toward the UK/EU. This is a full-ownership role: you set the market entry strategy and you deliver it, end to end. You'll also bring a go-to-market instinct—this is a new geography for us and you'll help us show up credibly.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

About The Team

The Merchant Central team builds and operates NMI's payments CRM and merchant lifecycle platform—the software that helps ISOs and ISVs manage deals, onboard merchants, underwrite risk, board to processors, run residuals, and support their portfolios. Our partners run their businesses on Merchant Central. The gateway has long had an international footprint, and this role brings the SaaS layer to match it. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, compliance, and go-to-market to expand what Merchant Central can do—and where it can go.

You Will

Own the international expansion roadmap for Merchant Central, phased by market: Canada first, then UK/EU, then determine what comes next.
Lead the integration of new strategic processors into Merchant Central from end to end—partner with Engineering on API specs, boarding flows, processor-specific configurations, local payment methods, and reconciliation
Research and document market requirements for each new geography: local payment methods, regulatory constraints, currency, language (ex French for Quebec), data residency, and compliance frameworks
Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and bug reports for the delivery team—you own delivery and strategy
Manage the product backlog: groom, prioritize, and sequence work to keep the team moving with clarity on scope and dependencies
Run or actively participate in sprint ceremonies: planning, review, retrospectives; own delivery visibility for your roadmap
Define the go-to-market approach for each market launch: positioning, partner messaging, launch readiness checklist, and sales/channel enablement
Partner with Product Marketing to develop external-facing content and messaging for new geographies—you understand what makes Canada (or the UK) different and you help us say it clearly
Build competitive intelligence for each target market: who are the incumbents, what do ISOs and ISVs expect, and where does NMI have a differentiated angle
Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on local licensing, data privacy (PIPEDA in Canada, GDPR in EU), tax treatment, and operational requirements
Define and track success metrics for each market launch: partner adoption, merchant volume, onboarding completion rates, and product utilization by geo
Use AI tools actively—market research, requirement synthesis, competitive analysis, documentation drafting—and bring that speed to your workflow

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Minimum Requirements

5+ years in product management with at least 3 years in payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS
Demonstrated experience taking a product into a new market or geography—you've done the research, built the requirements, and seen a market launch through to adoption
Hands-on product owner experience: you write user stories and acceptance criteria (or use AI to do so), manage Jira backlogs, and stay close to engineering through delivery
Strong understanding of payment localization: local payment methods, processor integrations, currency handling, regulatory compliance, and operational differences by market
GTM instincts: you've supported or led a product launch in a new market, contributed to positioning or messaging, and understand what it takes to enable a sales or channel team in an unfamiliar geography
Comfort operating in ambiguity—this market and this roadmap are being built; you don't need a finished blueprint to start
Data-driven: you define success metrics before you build and you use data to evaluate what's working
Excellent written communicator: your stories are clear, your requirements leave no room for interpretation, and your stakeholder updates are concise
Fluent with AI tools for product work—market research, spec drafting, synthesis, analysis

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with the Canadian payments ecosystem: Interac, Chase Paymentech Canada, Moneris or similar
Familiarity with Canadian regulatory requirements: PIPEDA, provincial privacy laws, French-language obligations in Quebec, FINTRAC
Experience with UK/EU payment regulation: PSD2, GDPR, FCA authorization frameworks, or SEPA
Experience working with product marketing: positioning, launch messaging, competitive battlecards, or partner enablement materials
Experience with SaaS CRM, merchant lifecycle, or partner-facing management platforms
Familiarity with Jira and agile delivery in a cross-functional product engineering environment

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

A remote first culture!
Competitive compensation and benefits
Personal growth and advancement opportunities
Flex PTO & dedicated sick time
Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
Life, ADD, Short-term and Long-term Disability insurance
401k matching up to 4% after two months of service
Flexible Spending Account
Paid Parental Leave
Company volunteer days
Employee referral program
Bonusly colleague recognition

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We're focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.

This is a remote role with an annual US base salary range of $120,000 – $145,000 USD. This salary range will be narrowed during the interview process based on experience, qualification, and location.

Equal Opportunity

We are an Equal Opportunities employer and will provide reasonable support throughout the recruitment process to applicants who have a disability. Please let us know in advance so that any support, aids or adaptations can be put in place to assist you.

NMI is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation or sexual identity, genetic information, citizen status (except those that do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States), disability, military service, service member, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. As part of the selection process this role may require an assessment and professional references to determine suitability. An offer will be subject to financial and criminal background checks.

Salary Range, Depending On Experience

$120,000—$145,000 USD

added.description:
OEC provides software solutions to those who work in the automotive parts and repair industry. Our solutions make it easier for automotive industry professionals to buy and sell parts, conduct repair research & planning, optimize estimates, improve the parts supply chain, and more. OEC partners with many of the world’s largest manufacturers, dealers and suppliers, shops and repairers, and service providers, giving our customers access to a comprehensive network and a streamlined workflow.

Why this role matters

The largest multi-shop collision operators in North America count on our platform every day. You'll be their product advocate: the person who understands their problems, rallies the teams who can solve them, and makes sure they get fast, clear answers.

What you'll do

Manage relationships with multiple large multi-shop operator accounts at once as their trusted product partner
Coordinate and negotiate across Sales, Support, Implementation, Engineering, and User Experience to balance customer needs with business priorities
Turn customer insight, market research, and data into a clear product roadmap and well-defined user stories
Shape marketplace capabilities across catalog, pricing, search, and transaction workflows
Explore artificial intelligence opportunities like automated matching, dynamic pricing, and predictive analytics
Track the metrics that matter, such as adoption, conversion, retention, and gross merchandise value, and lead go-to-market for new initiatives

What you bring

5+ years of enterprise business-to-business software product management
Proven success managing several large enterprise accounts at the same time
Strong negotiation skills and the ability to lead without direct authority
Experience with ecommerce or marketplace products
Technical fluency to weigh application programming interfaces, integrations, and architecture tradeoffs with Engineering
Comfort with Agile practices and hands-on use of artificial intelligence tools
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Bonus points

Automotive industry experience (highly preferred), especially in collision repair or parts procurement
Experience presenting strategy to executive leadership
Experience mentoring other product managers

The details

Travel up to 20% (about 1–2 days per month) to meet customers where they work.

What We Offer

Full benefits starting Day 1: Medical, Dental, and Vision
401(k) with company match
Unlimited Flex Time Off plus 10 company-paid holidays
Remote-first role with monthly communication stipend
Professional development programs and tuition assistance
Home office equipment stipend
Employee resource groups and exclusive employee discounts

What makes working at OEC awesome? It varies from employee to employee. For some, it's the flexibility - whether it's remote work or a hybrid or in-person role, OEC takes our teams across multiple time zones and international communities. For others, it's the strong sense of camaraderie and community that celebrates both individuals and team-driven contributions. Or it could be the empowerment and how the team is encouraged to take risks, learn, and grow within a dynamic and supportive environment. But no matter what gets us out of bed in the morning, our whole global community is inspired to be forward thinking and drive innovative solutions for the automotive parts and repair industry.

updated.title: VP, Product, Commerce Experiences & Marketplace
updated.description:
Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.

Job Description

Location:

New York, NY

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company's portfolio includes many of the world's most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.

The Role

This leadership role is a member of the Technology Leadership Team. The Vice President, Product, Commerce Experiences is a senior leadership role accountable for defining and executing the product strategy that drives the evolution of Condé Nast’s commerce ecosystem. This role will shape the future of commerce experiences across our brands, accelerating revenue growth, deepening consumer engagement, and leading the evolution of Conde Nast’s commerce ecosystem.

Condé Nast Core Affiliate Product Experience: Own and grow the affiliate commerce product as the foundation of the business, protecting and optimizing it as the current core commerce revenue surface
Condé Nast Commerce Evolution: Defining the future of commerce experiences across Condé Nast's brand portfolio, with particular focus on the next generation of marketplace operations inclusive of front-end AI powered discovery experiences, personalization, CRM capabilities and check-out experience
VETTE Platform Leadership: Define and execute the product vision for VETTE, our two-sided marketplace and creator storefront infrastructure, including the partner ecosystem, technology stack, and roadmap that supports its scale across brands and markets.

The VP will operate as a senior thought partner to the SVP Revenue Commerce, working across engineering, design, editorial, brand commerce leads, and external partners to bring a coherent product vision to life. This is a builder role with executive scope: the right candidate is fluent in both platform architecture and brand experience, comfortable moving between technical decisioning and brand-led storytelling, and credible across leadership, partner, and engineering conversations.

Key Responsibilities

Core Affiliate Product Ownership

Own the core affiliate commerce product including commerce content templates and optimizations, link infrastructure, attribution and measurement, network and merchant integrations, and product data quality.
Ensure affiliate performance is protected and grown alongside innovation tracks

Commerce Strategic Product Vision & Roadmap

Set the multi-year product vision for Condé Nast's commerce ecosystem including brand marketplace experiences and platform capabilities that drive growth, monetization, and audience engagement.
Own the end-to-end product experience of commerce customers on the Conde Nast commerce platform
Translate company-level commerce strategy into a coherent product roadmap with clear sequencing, success metrics, and investment cases
Lead product solutions to drive alternative monetization routes beyond core affiliate
Champion build vs. buy vs. partner decisions at a portfolio level, with appropriate trade-off analysis around speed, scalability, and editorial integrity
Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous learning, using data, customer feedback, and emerging technologies to identify new opportunities for growth.

VETTE Platform Ownership

As VETTE is currently powered by a start-up product acquired by Conde Nast in 2025, this role will lead the integration of the independent team into the internal ecosystem
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for VETTE, from marketplace mechanics and creator onboarding to merchant tooling, transaction flows, and analytics.
Lead architecture decisions in partnership with engineering leadership, ensuring scalability, performance, and integration reliability across a multi-brand environment.
Manage and evolve the VETTE tech stack, including infrastructure, third-party integrations, and internal tooling.
Drive monetisation, conversion, and retention improvements through a disciplined experimentation and prioritisation cadence.

Condé Nast Commerce Product Evolution & Front-End Experiences

Define the future state of commerce surfaces across the Condé Nast brand portfolio (Vogue, GQ, Allure, AD, Wired, Condé Nast Traveler, Bon Appétit, and beyond)
Champion customer-centric commerce experiences that connect content, discovery, personalization, and transaction journeys to drive engagement, conversion, and long-term customer value.
Shape the front-end experience strategy for AI-driven discovery, conversational commerce, and visual search, ensuring outputs inform rather than misrepresent product reality (a non-negotiable editorial guardrail).
Operationalise affiliate and marketplace product experiences across priority brands, in close partnership with brand commerce leads, editorial, and revenue teams.

Product Partnership & Ecosystem Strategy

Own senior relationships with strategic platform partners including Shopify, Amazon, Meta, Substack, Ethyca, and other infrastructure and distribution partners.
Scope, negotiate, and launch high-leverage integrations that unlock new marketplace capabilities or open new monetisation models.
Represent Condé Nast in partner forums, joint roadmap discussions, and co-development conversations.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing product organization spanning platform, marketplace, and brand-facing experiences. Establish product operating models, talent strategies, and ways of working that enable teams to deliver with ownership, speed, and clarity.
Operate as the primary bridge between business, engineering, design, editorial, and brand commerce stakeholders, with the credibility to broker decisions at pace while also driving alignment and shared ownership of outcomes
Define and evolve product operating models, prioritization frameworks, and delivery governance that support effective decision-making and execution across multiple teams and initiatives.
Lead sprint planning, prioritisation, and delivery rituals across multiple workstreams, maintaining visibility into timelines, dependencies, and trade-offs.
Foster a design-led, editorially literate product culture that respects the distinctiveness of each Condé Nast brand.

Required

About You

12+ years of product leadership experience, with at least 5 years at a Director or VP level managing complex platform or marketplace products.
Demonstrated track record defining and scaling marketplace, platform, or e-commerce products, and leading large-scale product, platform, or business model transformation initiatives in environments with high editorial or brand sensitivity.
Deep understanding of customer experience, conversion optimization, personalization, and consumer engagement strategies within digital commerce environments.
Experience owning and optimizing an affiliate or performance-commerce product, including attribution, network integrations, and yield.
Deep technical fluency across APIs, headless commerce, integration architecture, and modern front-end frameworks; able to engage substantively with engineering leadership on architecture decisions.
Experience building and leading high-performing product organizations through periods of growth, transformation, and organizational change.
Track record launching and managing strategic third-party integrations and platform partnerships.
Strong commercial instincts: comfortable owning P&L conversations, monetisation models, and investment cases.
Excellent executive communication skills, with experience presenting to boards, executive committees, and external partners.
Consultative approach and the ability to partner deeply with business experts to formulate and drive strategic recommendations for their area(s).
Gravitas to work with all levels of the organization, including with C-Suite executives.

Strong Plus Factors

Experience with the Shopify ecosystem, headless commerce, or unified checkout architectures.
Background in creator platforms, media tech, luxury commerce, or premium consumer marketplaces.
Familiarity with applied AI in commerce contexts (recommendation, conversational shopping, visual search) and the editorial guardrails these systems require.
Prior experience operating across the US and Western Europe markets.
Experience leading affiliate-to-marketplace or aggregator-to-platform business model transitions.

The expected base salary range for this position is from $270,000-$330,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.

What happens next?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

Job Description

We are seeking a talented and passionate Director of Product Management to lead a key area of our Venue Product organization and help shape Resy’s suite of B2B products for venue partners.

Our Venue products provide the tools that restaurants, wineries, and other hospitality venues rely on to manage their day-to-day operations and deliver exceptional hospitality. Through Resy OS, venue operators can configure user permissions and service settings, manage reservations and tables, understand their guests, and access real-time data and insights—all while delivering a seamless guest experience.

As a Director of Product Management, you will define and drive product vision and strategy across multiple squads and roadmaps. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Business leaders to translate customer needs, market opportunities, and company objectives into clear priorities and actionable plans.

You will play a critical role in connecting workstreams across the Venue Product organization, aligning teams around shared outcomes, and ensuring we invest in the opportunities that deliver the greatest value for our venue partners and the business. You will also help strengthen our product culture, develop product talent, and evolve how the team operates as we scale.

This role reports directly to Resy’s VP of Product Management.

Please note that this is a pipeline requisition to gather talent for future opportunities as a Product Director at Resy and Amex.

Responsibilities

Set product vision and strategy: Define a compelling long-term vision for your area of Venue Product and translate it into clear strategies, investment priorities, and roadmaps.
Represent the voice of our venue partners: Build a deep understanding of venue operators, their workflows, and evolving needs through direct customer engagement, research, data, and partnership with customer-facing teams.
Understand the market: Develop a strong perspective on the hospitality technology landscape, emerging customer needs, and competitive trends, using those insights to identify opportunities and inform product strategy.
Own product outcomes: Define and track success metrics across customer value, adoption, retention, growth, and operational performance, using insights to continuously refine product strategy and investment decisions.
Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and Business leaders to align priorities, connect roadmaps, identify dependencies, and ensure teams are working toward shared outcomes.
Enable high-quality execution: Establish clear ways of working across teams, proactively address dependencies, capacity constraints, and risks, and continuously improve how we deliver high-quality products at scale.
Partner on risk, compliance, and privacy: Work closely with stakeholders to ensure product enhancements meet applicable compliance, privacy, and risk standards.
Develop product talent and culture: Mentor and support Product Managers, strengthen product thinking and practices across the organization, and contribute to a culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

This role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is energized by B2B, SaaS, or marketplace products and enjoys solving complex problems at the intersection of customer needs, technology, and business strategy.

You are a collaborative and strategic leader who can move comfortably between setting direction and enabling execution. You bring clarity to ambiguity, build alignment across diverse stakeholders, and use data and customer insights to make thoughtful product decisions.

You’ll join a dynamic Product organization that values iteration, collaboration, curiosity, and data-informed decision-making—all in pursuit of our mission to connect diners with exceptional experiences and help our venue partners deliver world-class hospitality.

This is a hybrid role based in New York, NY or Chicago, IL.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex products, initiatives, or product areas.
Demonstrated ability to develop product vision and strategy and translate business objectives, customer needs, and market insights into clear priorities and roadmaps.
Strong analytical skills, with experience using qualitative and quantitative data to inform product decisions and measure outcomes.
Strong product judgment and a passion for technology, customer experience, and building products that solve meaningful problems.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, and UX Research, with a strong understanding of technical concepts, user experience, and product development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to communicate complex product strategy clearly and persuasively to senior executives and technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative and inclusive leadership style that values diverse perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds alignment across teams.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, navigate ambiguity and change, and bring structure to complex problems.
Creative and strategic problem-solving skills, including the ability to operate effectively in “white space” and develop solutions to new or evolving customer needs.
Thoughtful approach to product strategy, with an understanding of how to identify, assess, and navigate risk.
Proven track record of mentoring Product Managers and developing product talent.
A love of restaurants, dining, and hospitality—and an interest in helping the industry continue to thrive—is a plus.

updated.title: Principal Product Manager, Front End Platform
updated.description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

Job Description

Location:

New York, NY

Job Description

Condé Nast's audience platform is the front end that powers every digital experience across Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Bon Appétit, Vanity Fair, Wired and the rest of the portfolio. That means page performance, content rendering, ad delivery, SEO, design system components, accessibility and everything else that determines how millions of readers actually experience our brands on our owned properties and beyond. Wherever our content shows up (on-site, in apps, through syndication, on social, in search) the audience platform is the foundation. Advertisers depend on it. Brand teams build on it. It needs to be fast, beautiful and reliable.

We're looking for a Principal PM to own the strategy for this platform. Your job is to make sure our front end enables best-in-class experiences for every brand and every piece of content, wherever it reaches an audience. You'll need to deeply understand two things: what makes a great consumer experience and what makes a great platform for the teams building those experiences. That tension is core to the role and you should be energized by it.

You should also think about AI the way we do: not as a feature to bolt on but as something that changes how platform teams build, ship and maintain software. We want someone who's already working this way and can bring that mindset to how we evolve the audience platform.

The Role

You're a platform PM. But you're not here to build "platform value" in the abstract. You're here because the front end is where readers and advertisers meet our brands. Every decision you make should connect back to that.

You'll be the person who holds the full picture: page performance, content rendering, ad product delivery, SEO, design system consistency, accessibility, developer velocity. You'll work across brand teams to understand what they need. You'll partner deeply with engineering and design to figure out what to build and what to leave alone. You'll make hard calls about standardization vs. flexibility and you'll be able to explain why.

What You'll Do

Understand the customer. You have two. Readers who experience our brands through the audience platform and the internal teams who build on it. You spend real time understanding both. You know what good looks like for a consumer content experience across every surface (our own sites, apps, feeds, anywhere our content lives). You know what ad products need from the front end to perform. You don't treat "the platform" as an end in itself. It exists to make our brands' content shine wherever audiences find it.
Partner with eng and design. This is not a "throw requirements over the wall" role. You sit with engineering and design as a peer. You understand front end architecture well enough to have real conversations about trade-offs. You write clear specs. You also know when to stay loose and figure it out together.
Have a point of view on what great looks like. You know what best-in-class looks like for a consumer content experience and you hold us to that standard. You benchmark against the best publishers and platforms out there. You have real opinions about performance, page experience, ad density, load time, readability. You set targets that push toward the 95th percentile and you track them obsessively. But you also bring taste. You can look at a page and feel when something is off before the data tells you. The combination of metrics rigor and editorial instinct is what makes this role work.
Measure what matters. You define clear metrics for platform health: performance, quality, adoption, developer experience, consumer outcomes, ad delivery. You build dashboards and rituals that keep the team honest. You know the difference between a vanity metric and a useful one.
Get comfortable in the mess. Platform work at a multi-brand company is inherently messy with competing priorities, legacy systems and ambiguity about who owns what. You don't wait for things to be clean before you move. You can hold complexity without being paralyzed by it.
Think with AI, not just about it. You already use AI in your daily work. You've thought about where AI can meaningfully change platform workflows: component generation, documentation, QA, design-to-code pipelines, smarter defaults for brand teams. You can tell the difference between a demo that looks cool and a capability that actually reduces toil. You bring practical recommendations to the team and you help prioritize AI investment alongside everything else on the roadmap.
Stay curious. The front end landscape moves fast. You stay close to what's emerging in tooling, frameworks and AI-powered development. You bring perspective on what's worth adopting vs. what's noise. You read broadly and you form your own opinions.

What You Bring

10+ years in product management. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products. Multi-brand or multi-product experience is a strong plus.
Real understanding of front end technology. You know your way around rendering, performance optimization, SEO, component architecture and design systems. You don't write code but you can read a PR and follow a technical discussion.
Consumer product instincts. You've worked on products where the end user is a real person reading or watching or browsing. You understand engagement, retention and content experience quality. You pay attention to what competitors and best-in-class publishers are doing and you bring that context to your team.
Familiarity with digital advertising. You understand how ad products intersect with front end performance and UX. You know why page speed and layout stability matter to revenue and not just to Lighthouse scores.
Comfort with ambiguity. You've operated in large orgs where the path wasn't clear. You've driven alignment without direct authority across multiple teams with competing needs.
Strong communication skills. You write well. You present well. You can make platform strategy make sense to an editor-in-chief and a staff engineer in the same week.
You've worked across web and mobile (iOS/Android).
You're good with data and analytics tooling. You can define metrics and actually track them.

What We'd Love But Won't Require

Hands-on experience with design systems (Storybook, Figma component libraries, design tokens).
product strategy around AI capabilities and you can point to real examples.

updated.title: Director, Product Design - AI in Experience Design
updated.description:
The Experience Design (XD) team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences, and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Expectations

The role will work closely with our XD top of house team, including the SVP, Chief Design Officer and their Senior Leadership Team.

This Director will be responsible for building and owning the roadmaps across AI tooling, AI-enabled design process evolution, and AI-centric talent upskilling across Design at Capital One. With a destination-backed mindset, this leader will play both a strategic role in defining the vision of how Design works with AI and also be a player-coach role model for day-to-day implementation. Operating at the intersection of high-level strategy and hands-on execution, you will partner with Senior Executives across the Product, Engineering, and Design landscape across the experimentation and adoption curve in AI, and focus on building a roadmap that balances bold, big-picture thinking with immediate, actionable milestones.

The mission is twofold: to establish a definitive future vision for AI integration and to act as a catalyst for accelerating AI adoption across the Experience Design organization and beyond, balancing both risk and fast-paced innovation. We are looking for a seasoned design veteran who possesses the organizational rigor of a critical program lead, and maintains a deep, personal passion for AI experimentation—someone who isn't just watching the AI shift happen but is actively writing the future of design.

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Technical Change Management:
Drive transformative efficiency by architecting and scaling AI-driven design processes and tooling—including Claude, Gemini, and assistive IDEs—across the organization's highly matrixed environment. Define required workforce transformation ensuring new technical capabilities are seamlessly integrated into the operating model. Partner with executive leadership to bridge the gap between high-level innovation and disciplined execution to deliver measurable business value and experience excellence at scale

Product Design Expertise:
Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Strategic Influence:
Create an infrastructure for design leaders to shape product direction and outcomes by leveraging deep product design expertise, user insights, and an understanding of the business. Drive alignment with cross functional executive leaders, ensuring user needs are central to our overall strategy and enabling bold, innovative solutions to complex problems.

Human-Centered:
Recognize and pursue opportunities where customer needs and business goals coincide, while reinforcing with teammates and partners the importance of collecting and considering diverse customer perspectives throughout the design process

Business-Focused:
Demonstrate a mastery of products, processes, customers, competitors and broader industry trends and apply this knowledge to predict shifts in these areas and shape how Design should engage, uncover and solve significant business challenges

Problem-Solving:
Revel in the art of the possible, driving cross-functional groups in thinking creatively about potential solutions, illuminating potential pitfalls and fostering shared learnings; build frameworks for complex decision-making that enable effective debate and accelerate getting to the right solutions

Collaboration:
Connect the dots across the organization, proactively bringing together executive partners in ways that drive more coherent experiences, accelerate delivery and elevate the value of design

Communication:
Present work to executive leaders and stakeholders, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence change and drive strategic direction

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

Basic Qualifications:

At least 8 years of experience in a product design role

Preferred Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in a product design role
Experience leading a portfolio of work implementing AI processes and tools at scale in a design organization
Has experience in a design toolkit that spans product design, service design, and content design
Expertise with AI assistants tools like Claude or Gemini, agentic development like Claude Code, state machine visualizers like Stately, XState, and assistive tools like Windsurf
Experience leading high-impact, highly complex projects from strategy through delivery to market
Experience partnering with product managers, engineers, marketing, and analytics leaders across multiple business lines to shape strategy, OKRs, roadmaps, and operating models
Experience working within an established design system
Proficiency with web and mobile technologies and platforms, navigating technology considerations and constraints to drive sound product and experience decisions
Expertise with design and prototyping tools such as Figma
Proficiency in business case development, grounding product and user experience decisions to business value
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building across complex organizations
Exceptional people management and development skills

updated.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Infrastructure
updated.description:
Overview

Microsoft’s AI Infrastructure and Platforms organization is building the foundation that transforms rapid innovation in models, services, platform primitives, and hardware into scalable capabilities that customers and product teams can use.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy and critical workstreams for AI Capability Onboarding. This role owns how new capabilities enter the platform, become reusable building blocks, and progress from early innovation through packaging, launch, distribution, and lifecycle management.

You will create the product strategy, standards, interfaces, and reusable mechanisms that allow Microsoft to onboard an expanding portfolio of capabilities with greater speed, quality, and consistency. This is a highly visible senior individual-contributor role at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, efficiency, and complex cross-company collaboration.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Define and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for moving new AI capabilities from innovation to platform availability.
Lead the end-to-end capability onboarding portfolio, from intake and requirements through packaging, launch, catalog distribution, lifecycle management, and transition to production adoption.
Transform repeated launch activities, manual workflows, and bespoke integrations into reusable platform primitives, standardized contracts, automation, and self-service onboarding paths.
Translate customer, partner, market, and business needs into clear product requirements, launch criteria, investment priorities, and portfolio tradeoffs across capability types and providers.
Establish onboarding standards, decision rights, ownership boundaries, and handoff contracts across Product Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering, compliance, operations, and downstream product teams.
Partner with Engineering on technical feasibility, architecture implications, reliability, and platform investments, and with TPM on integrated plans, dependencies, risks, governance, and launch readiness.
Define and use outcome-based scorecards, including time to platform availability, onboarding throughput, launch success, standard-path adoption, capability reuse, and reduction in manual work, to guide investment decisions and continuously improve the onboarding system.

Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. This includes passing the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience in product/service or software development OR equivalent experience.
Demonstrated success owning product strategy for a technically complex platform, including defining the target customer, product value proposition, differentiated product direction, multi-year roadmap, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong platform product management experience, including turning fragmented workflows, repeated integrations, or one-off launches into reusable product capabilities, common contracts, scalable services, automation, and self-service experiences.
Technical depth in AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer platforms, or an adjacent domain, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture and feasibility discussions while maintaining clear accountability for the product’s what, why, customer focus, and success measures.
A record of leading consequential product decisions across multiple organizations using clear narratives, written strategy, evidence, decision frameworks, and executive communication to align senior product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
Strong analytical product judgment, including experience defining outcome-based metrics, instrumenting customer and platform journeys, interpreting telemetry and qualitative feedback, and using evidence to improve product direction after launch.
